April 26, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Bartlett & Co increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 281.48% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bartlett & Co bought 146,379 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 198,383 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.71 million, up from 52,004 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bartlett & Co who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $228.63 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.57% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $35.2. About 25.29 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.58% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
